question: 54.69% of the total workforce is engaged in _______ and allied sector activities (Census of India 2011).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agriculture.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Census of India** **2011**, **54.69%** of the total workforce is engaged in **agriculture and allied sector activities. **
 
• Agriculture is the primary occupation for a majority of the **rural population **in India and contributes significantly to the country's economy.
 
• It is worth noting that the** Census of India 2011 **also found that the percentage of the workforce engaged in agriculture has been declining over the years, indicating a shift towards other sectors of the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hunting and gathering** is not a significant occupation in India and is mostly carried out by **tribal communities** in remote areas.
 
• **Manufacturing** is a growing sector in India but employs a** smaller percentage** of the workforce compared to agriculture.
 
• **Mining **is a relatively small sector in India and employs a** small percentage **of the workforce.
 
• The home listing and population enumeration stages of the 2011 Indian census, also known as the** 15th Indian census**, were carried out separately.
 
• As per the provisional reports that were made public on** March 31, 2011**, the population of India grew by** 17.70%** over a decade to reach **1.21 billion people.**
 
• With a decadal growth of **9.21%**, the adult literacy rate rose to **74.04%.**
 
• **"Our Census, Our Future**" served as the census's motto.
